optimizedDescription.value: `specd specs implementation` CLI: list/add/remove persisted implementation links via Kernel.specs; no CLI-owned mutation logic.

optimizedContext.value:
# Specs Implementation CLI

## Rules

- Command group `specd specs implementation`; every subcommand accepts `--format text|json|toon` (default text).
- `list <spec-id>` → call `Kernel.specs.getPersistedImplementation`, print link list; distinguish file-level entries (no `symbols`) from symbol-level (`symbols` present).
- Uninitialized spec in `list`: MUST report spec not initialized, never indistinguishable empty list; text output distinguishes cases, JSON/TOON include `initialized` field.
- `add <spec-id> --file <path> [--symbol <name>...]` → `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedImplementation` with `action: add`, raw `--file` value, supplied `--symbol` values; print resulting persisted list.
- `remove <spec-id> --file <path> [--symbol <name>...]` → same call with `action: remove`; print resulting persisted list.
- Handlers MUST NOT perform file-existence checks, canonical `workspace:path` normalization, workspace-boundary validation, or persisted-state writes. Every mutation = one `updatePersistedImplementation` call, flags mapped directly onto `UpdatePersistedSpecImplementationInput`.
- Users supply raw project-relative paths (same form accepted by `specd changes implementation`); never require canonical `workspace:path` input — normalization belongs to `UpdatePersistedSpecImplementation`.
- Error mapping, exit code 1 with `error:` message: `SpecNotFoundError` names unresolved spec; `ImplementationFileNotFoundError` + `ImplementationWorkspaceBoundaryError` describe invalid path; `ArtifactConflictError` reports concurrent modification, instruct retry; `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` gives no configuration workaround.

## Constraints

- Never read/write spec-lock.json directly; every operation flows through Kernel.specs.getPersistedImplementation / Kernel.specs.updatePersistedImplementation.
- Distinct from `changes implementation`: operates on canonical post-archive persisted state, not change-time tracked files/confirmed links.
- Every leaf subcommand calls `.allowExcessArguments(false)`
